title: 人工智能，从零搭建 · 第16部分：稀疏性

chapters.Outro: 回顾，以及这些想法会在哪里再现

d0b144510bf2.en: DeepSeek-V3 has six hundred and seventy-one billion parameters. <bookmark mark='a'/> But for each token it reads, it uses only 37 billion of them. Each of its expert layers holds 256 small networks, called experts, and a router sends each token to just 8 of them, plus one that everyone shares. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch: every word lights up a different few.
d0b144510bf2.zh: DeepSeek-V3有6710亿个参数。<bookmark mark='a'/>可是它每读一个词元，只用到其中的370亿个。它的每个专家层里都有256个小网络，叫作专家；一个路由器把每个词元只送到其中8个那里，再加上一个所有词元都共用的专家。<bookmark mark='b'/>看：每个词点亮的，都是不同的那几个。

1a64200449f8.en: This part is about using only some of a model at a time: how a router chooses, how to keep every expert busy, what the experts learn, <bookmark mark='a'/> and how attention, too, can look at only what matters.
1a64200449f8.zh: 这一部分讲的是，每次只动用模型的一部分：路由器怎样做选择，怎样让每个专家都有活干，专家们学到了什么，<bookmark mark='a'/>以及注意力怎样也能只看要紧的东西。

28b743605d12.en: Chapter one. A mixture of experts.

27e2e22c45fe.en: Here's one layer. Instead of one big network, it holds several smaller ones, the experts. <bookmark mark='a'/> A router, just one more matrix, scores the token against every expert, and a softmax turns the scores into probabilities. <bookmark mark='b'/> Only the top k experts run: here, two of eight. <bookmark mark='c'/> Their outputs are mixed, weighted by the router's probabilities. The idea is from 1991; Noam Shazeer and colleagues made it sparse, and huge, in 2017.
27e2e22c45fe.zh: 这是其中的一层。它装的不是一个大网络，而是几个小一些的网络，也就是专家。<bookmark mark='a'/>路由器只不过是又一个矩阵：它让这个词元和每个专家都比一比，打出分数，再由softmax把分数变成概率。<bookmark mark='b'/>只有得分最高的k个专家会运行：这里是8个里的2个。<bookmark mark='c'/>它们的输出按路由器给的概率加权，混合起来。这个想法早在1991年就有了；2017年，诺姆·沙泽尔和同事们让它变得稀疏，也让它变得极其庞大。

626c49cde5aa.en: Almost every frontier model now works this way. <bookmark mark='a'/> Mixtral used two experts of eight. DeepSeek-V3 uses 8 of 256; Kimi K2 has a trillion parameters and uses thirty-two billion; Qwen3-Next, 10 of 512, under four percent of its weights per token. <bookmark mark='b'/> The model knows as much as its total size, roughly, and costs as much to run as its active size.
626c49cde5aa.zh: 如今，几乎每一个前沿模型都是这样工作的。<bookmark mark='a'/>Mixtral用的是8个专家里的2个。DeepSeek-V3用256个里的8个；Kimi K2有1万亿个参数，用到的是320亿个；Qwen3-Next是512个里的10个，每个词元用到的权重不到4%。<bookmark mark='b'/>大致说来，模型懂得多少，和它的总规模相当；运行起来花多少，却只和它激活的那部分相当。

459808f13c04.en: Here is DeepSeek-V3's router exactly, since it's become a template. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each expert gets a score from a sigmoid, its own yes-or-no, rather than a softmax that makes experts compete. <bookmark mark='b'/> The top k are chosen by score plus a bias, the balancing bias of the next chapter. <bookmark mark='c'/> But the weights that mix the chosen experts use the scores alone, rescaled to add to one, so balancing never distorts what the model computes. <bookmark mark='d'/> And one shared expert sees every token, to hold what everything needs. Each expert is an FFN, a feed-forward network: the same thing as part thirteen's MLP. <bookmark mark='e'/> Why so many small experts? Count the combinations. Two of sixteen experts can be paired 120 ways. Cut each expert into four and choose eight of sixty-four, for the same compute, and there are 4.4 billion ways: far more room for each token to get its own specialized mixture.
459808f13c04.zh: 下面是DeepSeek-V3路由器的具体做法，因为它已经成了一个模板。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个专家的分数来自一个sigmoid，是它自己的“要不要”，而不是让专家们彼此竞争的softmax。<bookmark mark='b'/>前k个专家，按分数加上一个偏置来挑选，就是下一章那个用来均衡的偏置。<bookmark mark='c'/>可是，混合被选中专家的权重只用分数本身，重新缩放、使总和为1，所以均衡永远不会扭曲模型算出的结果。<bookmark mark='d'/>另外还有一个共享专家，每个词元都会经过它，用来承载所有词元都需要的东西。每个专家都是一个FFN，也就是前馈网络：和第13部分的MLP是同一种东西。<bookmark mark='e'/>为什么要这么多小专家？数一数组合就知道了。从16个专家里选2个，有120种搭配。把每个专家切成4份，在同样的计算量下从64个里选8个，就有44亿种：每个词元都有大得多的余地，得到属于自己的专门组合。

c08319811eeb.en: Chapter two. Keeping every expert busy.
c08319811eeb.zh: 第2章。让每个专家都有活干。

56b30395d417.en: We built one: Part twelve's character model, with its hidden layer split into 8 experts and 2 used for each character. Train it, and watch how the characters are shared out. <bookmark mark='a'/> Left alone, the router plays favourites: the busiest expert ends up with 3.2 times its fair share, while others starve. <bookmark mark='b'/> It's a rich-get-richer loop: a favoured expert gets more practice, gets better, and gets chosen even more. Starved experts are wasted parameters.
56b30395d417.zh: 我们自己搭了一个：就是第12部分的那个字符模型，把它的隐藏层拆成8个专家，每个字符用其中2个。训练它，看看字符是怎样分下去的。<bookmark mark='a'/>放任不管的话，路由器就会偏心：最忙的那个专家，最后分到了公平份额的3.2倍，而另一些专家却在挨饿。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是一个富者愈富的循环：受偏爱的专家练得更多，变得更好，于是被选中得更多。挨饿的专家，就是白白浪费的参数。

8a9022e95074.en: Two fixes. <bookmark mark='a'/> The classic one adds a penalty to the loss: the share of characters each expert gets, times its average router probability, summed. It's smallest when every expert gets an equal share. But it's a second goal competing with the first. <bookmark mark='b'/> DeepSeek-V3's fix adds no loss at all. Each expert gets a bias, used only for choosing, never for mixing: after every step, busy experts' biases go down a notch and idle experts' go up. <bookmark mark='c'/> At the strength Google's Switch Transformer used in 2021, the penalty only partly evens it out: its busiest expert still gets 2.8 times a fair share, while the bias holds every expert within 1.1. Held-out bits: 2.453 unbalanced, 2.410 with the penalty, 2.434 with the bias.
8a9022e95074.zh: 有两种办法。<bookmark mark='a'/>经典的办法，是在损失里加一个惩罚项：每个专家分到的字符份额，乘以它的平均路由概率，再全部加起来。每个专家分得一样多时，它最小。可是，这是第二个目标，会和第一个目标相互竞争。<bookmark mark='b'/>DeepSeek-V3的办法，完全不加损失。每个专家都有一个偏置，只用来做选择，从不用来混合：每走一步，忙的专家，偏置就调低一格；闲的专家，偏置就调高一格。<bookmark mark='c'/>按Google的Switch Transformer在2021年用的强度，惩罚项只能把负载拉平一部分：它最忙的专家，仍然分到公平份额的2.8倍；而偏置让每个专家都保持在1.1倍以内。留出文本上的比特数：不做均衡是2.453，加惩罚项是2.410，用偏置是2.434。

50e0d45f7a71.en: Here is all of training, replayed: each bar is one expert's share of the characters, under each of the three rules. <bookmark mark='a'/> Watch the left: shares drift apart as some experts win. In the middle, the penalty pulls them only part of the way back; on the right, the bias keeps every expert close to its fair share.
50e0d45f7a71.zh: 这是整个训练过程的回放：在三种规则下，每根柱子都是一个专家分到的字符份额。<bookmark mark='a'/>看左边：随着一些专家胜出，份额越拉越开。中间，惩罚项只把它们往回拉了一部分；右边，偏置让每个专家都贴近它的公平份额。

cc52842f5897.en: What do the experts learn? Here's where our balanced model sends each character's context: one column per character just read, one row per expert. <bookmark mark='a'/> Some patterns appear: 3 of the 5 vowels go first to expert 5, and 6 of the 8 spaces and punctuation marks to experts 3 and 8. Nobody told it to. But it isn't a tidy division by meaning: in large models too, experts tend to split the work along surface patterns like these.
cc52842f5897.zh: 专家们学到了什么？这里是我们那个均衡过的模型，把每个字符的上下文送到了哪里：每一列是刚读到的一个字符，每一行是一个专家。<bookmark mark='a'/>能看出一些规律：5个元音里，有3个首先送往5号专家；8个空格和标点里，有6个送往3号和8号专家。没有人这样教过它。可这并不是按含义整整齐齐的分工：在大模型里也一样，专家往往是沿着这类表面的模式来分工的。

cb63a0b4b3ce.en: How did that pattern form? Here is the same picture during training. <bookmark mark='a'/> At the start the router is random and nearly uniform, so each character's contexts are spread over the experts: on average its favourite gets 41 percent. <bookmark mark='b'/> Within 100 steps the router commits hard: the favourite's share jumps to 82 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then the balancing bias pushes back, lowering the bias of experts that are too busy, and the choices spread out again, to 58 percent by the end. The favourites keep changing for a long time: 17 of the 30 characters still switch expert after step 300, and 8 after step 1,000.
cb63a0b4b3ce.zh: 那个规律是怎么形成的？这是训练途中的同一张图。<bookmark mark='a'/>一开始，路由器是随机的，几乎均匀，所以每个字符的上下文都分散在各个专家上：它最常去的那个专家平均只拿到41%。<bookmark mark='b'/>100步之内，路由器就下了重注：最常去的专家的份额跳到82%。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后负载均衡的偏置开始反推，降低那些太忙的专家的偏置，选择又分散开来，到最后是58%。最常去的专家会变很久：30个字符里，有17个在第300步之后还会换专家，第1000步之后还有8个。

1016a92ed0ef.en: And here are the three models of that comparison as they train. <bookmark mark='w'/> Two are dense: ordinary layers, where every weight works on every token. The third is the mixture, where each token uses only a few experts. Held-out bits per character every 150 steps. <bookmark mark='a'/> The mixture pulls ahead of the dense model with the same arithmetic by step 1,800 and stays ahead. <bookmark mark='b'/> The wide dense model, 8 experts' width, trails the whole way: with this little training, all those parameters haven't paid off yet.
1016a92ed0ef.zh: 这是那组比较里的三个模型在训练中的样子。<bookmark mark='w'/>其中两个是稠密模型：普通的层，每个权重都作用在每个词元上。第三个是混合专家模型，每个词元只用到少数几个专家。每150步测一次留出文本上的每字符比特数。<bookmark mark='a'/>混合专家模型在第1800步时超过了计算量相同的稠密模型，并且一直领先。<bookmark mark='b'/>那个宽的稠密模型，有8个专家那么宽，一路落后：训练这么少，那么多参数还没来得及发挥作用。

dd96b869b310.en: Is it worth it? Compare three models. <bookmark mark='a'/> A dense one doing as much arithmetic per character as the mixture; the mixture; and a dense one with as many parameters in total. <bookmark mark='b'/> The mixture, 2.434, beats the dense model with the same arithmetic, 2.485. And with the same short training, the dense model with all the parameters does no better, 2.510: eight times the width is more to learn, and it hasn't caught up. At scale, that's the trade the biggest models make: knowledge in the total, cost in the active.
dd96b869b310.zh: 这样做值得吗？比较三个模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个稠密模型，每个字符做的运算和混合模型一样多；混合模型本身；再加一个稠密模型，参数总数和混合模型一样多。<bookmark mark='b'/>混合模型是2.434，胜过了运算量相同的稠密模型，2.485。而在同样短的训练下，拥有全部参数的那个稠密模型，也没有更好，是2.510：宽了8倍，要学的东西就更多，它还没有赶上来。到了大规模，这正是最大的那些模型所做的交换：知识看总参数，开销看激活参数。

6b5bb77ab3db.en: Attention looks at every earlier token, but how much of that does it use? Take part thirteen's transformer and, for each query, rank its keys by weight. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each line is one head: how much of the attention its top k keys hold. On average, the top sixteen keys, out of between a hundred and twenty-eight and two hundred and fifty-six, hold 92 percent. Most of the attention goes to a few keys.
6b5bb77ab3db.zh: 注意力会看前面的每一个词元，可是它真正用上了多少？拿第13部分的Transformer来说，对每个查询，把它的键按权重排个序。<bookmark mark='a'/>每条线是一个头：它权重最高的k个键，占了多少注意力。平均来说，在128到256个键里，权重最高的16个，就占了92%。大部分注意力，都落在少数几个键上。

a17b43f41914.en: So let each query use only k keys. Which k? <bookmark mark='a'/> The simplest choice is the most recent ones, a sliding window: with 8 keys, 1.85 bits a character. <bookmark mark='b'/> Better, take the 8 keys it would weight most: 1.80. With 64, it's within a thousandth of a bit of using everything.
a17b43f41914.zh: 那就让每个查询只用k个键。用哪k个？<bookmark mark='a'/>最简单的选法，是最近的那几个，也就是滑动窗口：用8个键，每字符1.85比特。<bookmark mark='b'/>更好的办法，是取它本来会给出最高权重的那8个键：1.80。用64个键时，和用上全部的键相比，差距不到千分之一比特。

6b0c8758e652.en: Choosing by score is what real models now do. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here's one query in our transformer, and how it weighs its last forty-eight keys. Together they hold 90 percent of its attention, and most of it lands on a handful of characters well back from the end. <bookmark mark='b'/> A sliding window keeps only the last eight keys: they hold just 7 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> DeepSeek's native sparse attention cuts the past into blocks and squeezes each one into a summary. <bookmark mark='d'/> The query scores the summaries, reads the best blocks in full, and keeps a window of recent tokens too: 75 percent, from 16 keys. <bookmark mark='e'/> In DeepSeek-V3.2, a tiny, fast indexer gives every past token a score, and the query attends to the top ones only: two thousand and forty-eight in the real model, eight here, holding 76 percent. <bookmark mark='f'/> The trick in both is that finding the important keys must be much cheaper than attending to all of them.
6b0c8758e652.zh: 按分数来选，正是如今真实的模型在做的事。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是我们Transformer里的一个查询，以及它怎样给最后48个键分配权重。这48个键加起来，占了它90%的注意力，而且大部分落在离末尾相当远的少数几个字符上。<bookmark mark='b'/>滑动窗口只留下最后8个键：它们只占7%。<bookmark mark='c'/>DeepSeek的原生稀疏注意力，把过去切成一块一块，再把每一块压缩成一个摘要。<bookmark mark='d'/>查询先给这些摘要打分，把最好的几块完整地读一遍，同时也保留一个最近词元的窗口：75%，用了16个键。<bookmark mark='e'/>在DeepSeek-V3.2里，一个又小又快的索引器，给过去的每个词元打一个分，查询只关注得分最高的那些：真实模型里是2048个，这里是8个，占了76%。<bookmark mark='f'/>两者的诀窍都在于：找出重要的键，必须比对所有的键都做一遍注意力，便宜得多。

1519e1d34070.en: In equations: <bookmark mark='a'/> NSA's output is a gated sum of three attentions, over the block summaries, over the chosen blocks in full, and over a recent window, with gates the model learns. <bookmark mark='b'/> DSA's indexer scores each past token with a few small heads: a weighted sum of rectified dot products, where any negative score is set to zero, part nine's ReLU, all computed in eight-bit numbers: each rounded to one of two hundred and fifty-six values, to save time and memory. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then real attention runs over the top two thousand and forty-eight. <bookmark mark='d'/> The indexer still looks at every pair, but it's so small that the expensive part now grows with the length times two thousand, not the length squared.
1519e1d34070.zh: 写成公式：<bookmark mark='a'/>NSA的输出，是三种注意力的门控加权和：对块摘要的注意力，对选中的块完整读取的注意力，以及对最近一段窗口的注意力，门由模型自己学。<bookmark mark='b'/>DSA的索引器，用几个小小的头给过去的每个词元打分：一组经过整流的点积的加权和，也就是把负的分数都置为0，这是第9部分的ReLU；全部用8位数来算：每个数都舍入成256个值中的一个，以节省时间和内存。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后，真正的注意力只在得分最高的2048个词元上进行。<bookmark mark='d'/>索引器仍然要看每一对，但它小到这种程度，昂贵的那部分就变成随长度乘以2000增长，而不是随长度的平方增长。

149c1536e75f.en: Let's take stock. A mixture of experts keeps many networks in each layer and runs only a few per token, chosen by a router: frontier models now use a few percent of their weights at a time. Routers play favourites unless balanced, partly by a penalty, and fully, in our model, by DeepSeek's loss-free bias. The experts split the work by themselves, and the mixture buys the knowledge of a big model at the cost of a small one. And attention is sparse too: a few keys hold most of each query's weight, and choosing keys by score beats choosing the most recent.
149c1536e75f.zh: 我们来盘点一下。混合专家在每一层里放许多个网络，每个词元只运行其中几个，由路由器来挑：如今的前沿模型，每次只用到百分之几的权重。路由器会偏心，除非加以均衡：惩罚项能做到一部分；而在我们的模型里，DeepSeek那个不加损失的偏置，能完全做到。专家们会自己分工，而混合模型用小模型的开销，换来了大模型的知识。注意力也是稀疏的：少数几个键，就占了每个查询的大部分权重；按分数来选键，胜过选最近的键。

2b8df25cc954.en: Image and video models route by experts too, in part twenty-two. Spreading hundreds of experts across many chips is a serving problem, in part nineteen. And sparsity returns in part thirty, inside the network's own activity: features that light up only rarely.
2b8df25cc954.zh: 图像和视频模型也会按专家来路由，这在第22部分。把几百个专家分散到许多块芯片上，是部署服务的问题，这在第19部分。稀疏性还会在第30部分回来，就在网络自身的活动里：那些很少才亮起来的特征。

39ea70f9463f.en: Next time, act three turns from text to everything else. Diffusion and flow models start from pure noise <bookmark mark='a'/> and, guessing one small step at a time, carry it to a picture: part five's Brownian motion, run backwards.
39ea70f9463f.zh: 下一次，第三幕从文本转向其他一切。扩散模型和流模型，从纯粹的噪声出发，<bookmark mark='a'/>每次猜一小步，一步步把它带成一幅图像：这就是第5部分的布朗运动，倒过来运行。

41912746dda8.en: The Switch Transformer paper is the clearest introduction. Thanks for watching, and see you in part twenty-one.
41912746dda8.zh: 要入门，Switch Transformer那篇论文讲得最清楚。感谢观看，我们第21部分再见。

Each expert gets a bias, used only for choosing, never for mixing: after every step, busy experts' biases go down a notch and idle experts' go up. <bookmark mark='c'/> At the strength Google's Switch Transformer used in 2021, the penalty only partly evens it out: its busiest expert still gets 2.7 times a fair share, while the bias holds every expert within 1.1. Held-out bits: 2.457 unbalanced, 2.414 with the penalty, 2.431 with the bias.
16d0ce1b023e.zh: 有两种办法。<bookmark mark='a'/>经典的办法，是在损失里加一个惩罚项：每个专家分到的字符份额，乘以它的平均路由概率，再全部加起来。每个专家分得一样多时，它最小。可是，这是第二个目标，会和第一个目标相互竞争。<bookmark mark='b'/>DeepSeek-V3的办法，完全不加损失。每个专家都有一个偏置，只用来做选择，从不用来混合：每走一步，忙的专家，偏置就调低一格；闲的专家，偏置就调高一格。<bookmark mark='c'/>按Google的Switch Transformer在2021年用的强度，惩罚项只能把负载拉平一部分：它最忙的专家，仍然分到公平份额的2.7倍；而偏置让每个专家都保持在1.1倍以内。留出文本上的比特数：不做均衡是2.457，加惩罚项是2.414，用偏置是2.431。

33eb079e92cf.en: How did that pattern form? Here is the same picture during training. <bookmark mark='a'/> At the start the router is random and nearly uniform, so each character's contexts are spread over the experts: on average its favourite gets 41 percent. <bookmark mark='b'/> Within 100 steps the router commits hard: the favourite's share jumps to 82 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then the balancing bias pushes back, lowering the bias of experts that are too busy, and the choices spread out again, to 56 percent by the end. The favourites keep changing for a long time: 16 of the 30 characters still switch expert after step 300, and 12 after step 1,000.
33eb079e92cf.zh: 那个规律是怎么形成的？这是训练途中的同一张图。<bookmark mark='a'/>一开始，路由器是随机的，几乎均匀，所以每个字符的上下文都分散在各个专家上：它最常去的那个专家平均只拿到41%。<bookmark mark='b'/>100步之内，路由器就下了重注：最常去的专家的份额跳到82%。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后负载均衡的偏置开始反推，降低那些太忙的专家的偏置，选择又分散开来，到最后是56%。最常去的专家会变很久：30个字符里，有16个在第300步之后还会换专家，第1000步之后还有12个。

ce571004c91a.en: Is it worth it? Compare three models. <bookmark mark='a'/> A dense one doing as much arithmetic per character as the mixture; the mixture; and a dense one with as many parameters in total. <bookmark mark='b'/> The mixture, 2.431, beats the dense model with the same arithmetic, 2.485. And with the same short training, the dense model with all the parameters does no better, 2.510: eight times the width is more to learn, and it hasn't caught up. At scale, that's the trade the biggest models make: knowledge in the total, cost in the active.
ce571004c91a.zh: 这样做值得吗？比较三个模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个稠密模型，每个字符做的运算和混合模型一样多；混合模型本身；再加一个稠密模型，参数总数和混合模型一样多。<bookmark mark='b'/>混合模型是2.431，胜过了运算量相同的稠密模型，2.485。而在同样短的训练下，拥有全部参数的那个稠密模型，也没有更好，是2.510：宽了8倍，要学的东西就更多，它还没有赶上来。到了大规模，这正是最大的那些模型所做的交换：知识看总参数，开销看激活参数。
